label: <DEL> delimiter in short sequences (L<=5), plus weak early-original firing on certain tokens
explanation: Mainly a delimiter-step unit. About 77% of activation mass falls on the <DEL> step, where it fires in 92% of sequences with L<=5 and almost never for longer ones. It is strongest for L=3-4, where all the top activations are <DEL> after 3 tokens. The other part is weak firing during the original phase at t=2-3, mostly on tokens 2, n, q, o, c, t and nearly always on the first occurrence of the token; this part depends on the token and is noisy. It never fires at t=0-1, at t>=8, or anywhere in the copy phase. The two-clause predicate gives dev F1 0.76 and mass recall 0.92. Most misses are low-magnitude original-phase steps on other tokens.
